question:
Choose the idiom / phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

All the boys of Shemrock are **similar in many ways**.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Birds of a feather"** means people who have similar interests, ideas, or characteristics tend to group together. (एक जैसे लोग एक साथ रहते हैं)

 
 
• **Example:** **Birds of a feather** flock together, so it's no surprise that all the artists hang out in the same café.
 
 

Therefore, the correct idiom for the given phrase is **'Birds of a feather.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flocking birds** (झुंड में पक्षी): Refers to birds that gather or move in a group.

 
 
• **Example: Flocking birds **can often be seen flying south for the winter.
 
 
 
• **Eats like a bird** (बहुत कम खाना): Refers to someone who eats very little.
 
 
• **Example:** She** eats like a bird**, just picking at her food.
 
 
 
• **A piece of cake** (बहुत आसान): Refers to something that is very easy to do.
 
 
• **Example:** Solving this puzzle was **a piece of cake** for her.
 
 

 

3d:Tc42,
The correct answer is **Option 4)**
